Container.Name: JellyLooter
Container.Overview: JellyLooter v4.0.0 - Sync media from remote Jellyfin/Emby servers to your local storage. NEW in v4.0.0: - Redesigned interface (Clean Grid or Dashboard layout) with poster sizes, quality badges and page navigation - Smarter duplicate detection (IMDb/TMDB/TVDB/AniDB IDs plus title and year) - owned items show a green check - Visual folder picker, Season folders and optional Specials, Sync Media / Sync Duplicate Media - Upgrading from v3.x keeps all servers, logins, mappings and settings FREE Features: - Browse and download from 2 remote servers, 1 local server for duplicate detection, 1 sync mapping - Season folders, folder naming with IDs, subtitles, auto-retry - TMDB / TVDB / OMDb metadata keys, download history and basic stats - English, Spanish and German PRO Features ($10 lifetime): - Unlimited servers and sync mappings, up to 10 concurrent downloads - Multi-connection downloads with crash-safe resume and file verification - Download when a server blocks downloads (original-quality stream) - Built-in WireGuard VPN with kill switch (Proton, PIA, Mullvad, IVPN, AirVPN, Windscribe, Surfshark, any WireGuard) - Sonarr / Radarr / Lidarr integration (added automatically when you download) - GPU transcoding (NVIDIA NVENC, Intel QuickSync, AMD VAAPI), scheduling, per-server downloads - Notifications (Discord, Telegram, 80+ services), detailed statistics, holiday themes GPU: NVIDIA - install the Nvidia-Driver plugin, add --runtime=nvidia to Extra Parameters and fill in the NVIDIA variables. Intel/AMD - fill in the /dev/dri device. VPN (Pro): add --cap-add=NET_ADMIN to Extra Parameters. Get Pro: https://lightwave43.gumroad.com/l/rmtmrr

Config.Name: Storage Path
Config.Description: Your media share - downloads are saved inside it (for example /mnt/user/data/media)

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Your timezone (for logs and schedules), e.g. America/New_York, Europe/London

Config.Name: Cache Path (Pro)
Config.Description: (Pro) Optional fast cache drive for transcoding - transcode there, then move to the array

Config.Name: NVIDIA Visible Devices (Pro GPU)
Config.Description: (Pro GPU) 'all' or a GPU UUID. Also add --runtime=nvidia to Extra Parameters.

Config.Name: NVIDIA Driver Capabilities (Pro GPU)
Config.Description: (Pro GPU) Set to compute,video,utility for NVIDIA encoding

Config.Name: Intel QuickSync / AMD VAAPI (Pro GPU)
Config.Description: (Pro GPU) Set to /dev/dri to use an Intel or AMD GPU for transcoding
